title: CI/CD with AWS CodePipeline
description: Automate build, test, and deployment to AWS using CodePipeline and CodeBuild.

data.text: AWS CodePipeline automates the build, test, and deployment phases of your release process. Combined with CodeBuild and Elastic Beanstalk or ECS, it creates a fully automated CI/CD pipeline.

items: **Source** — GitHub, CodeCommit, or S3 triggers the pipeline
**Build** — CodeBuild compiles, tests, and packages the app
**Deploy** — Elastic Beanstalk or ECS deploys the new version

data.title: buildspec.yml for ASP.NET Core
data.content:
Create a `buildspec.yml` in the root of your repository.
# Expected output: Each phase logs success and artifacts are stored in S3.
data.code:
version: 0.2

phases:
  install:
    runtime-versions:
      dotnet: 8.0
    commands:
      - dotnet --version

  pre_build:
    commands:
      - dotnet restore

  build:
    commands:
      - dotnet build --no-restore --configuration Release
      - dotnet test --no-build --verbosity normal
      - dotnet publish --configuration Release --output ./publish

  post_build:
    commands:
      - echo Build completed on `date`
artifacts:
  files:
    - '**/*'
  base-directory: publish

points: CodePipeline orchestrates source, build, and deploy stages
GitHub integration enables automated deployments on every push
